title: A duplicate cancel rejection reopens an ended UI transfer
trigger: Submit Cancel(id) twice while processing. Cancel remains enabled for Stage::Running. Controller emits Cancelled(id), then ActionRejected(id, Stale), since the first cancel removed its lease.
impact: The late rejection resets Stage::Ended to Upload/Download; ordinary input and close stay blocked by the resurrected UI card although the bridge lease has ended. Re-prepare/re-cancel is stale and cannot end the resurrected card.
evidence: terminal_zmodem.rs:421 admits a second Cancel for the same current UUID, regardless of Stage
terminal_zmodem.rs:647-655 leaves cancel enabled in Running
session zmodem.rs:485-487 rejects a stale second cancel after end clears transfer
terminal_zmodem.rs:334-357 does not reject post-terminal ActionRejected notifications
verification: Source-level control-flow proof only; no new test compiled.
